services.name: Camp Foley Group Site
services.desc: NEW THIS YEAR: The Reservation Holder is required to register and pick up access keys from Hosts at Tamihi West Campground. Camp Foley is a small, 4 site Private Group Campground located along the banks of the Chilliwack River. This site is as popular for small family gatherings as it is for a couples get away. It is accessible by car on paved road, but is also conveniently located at the beginning of Bench FSR, the starting place for off-road adventures in the Chilliwack River Valley. Fishing is not permitted on this stretch of the river. The site is equipped with 4 fire rings, 4 picnic tables, and 1 pit toilet. There is no running water or garbage collection on site.
